# GitHubShareClient

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Publish.Community` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public sealed class GitHubShareClient
```

The GitHub REST calls sharing needs. The token goes only in the `Authorization` header of requests to the endpoints' API and uploads hosts: never to the published list, never into a message. Every failure leaves as a [`ShareRules`](Nfty.Core.Publish.Community.ShareRules.md) sentence: [`GitHubAuthException`](Nfty.Core.Publish.Community.GitHubAuthException.md) for a refused token, [`CommunityException`](Nfty.Core.Publish.Community.CommunityException.md) for the rest. A caller's own cancellation stays an `OperationCanceledException`.

- `bodyTimeout` (`TimeSpan?`) - How long a response body may take once its headers arrived (default 30 seconds).
